definition.name: Check consumer future admission, deferred replay and retirement

steps.name: Run exact source-bound ownership controls
steps.run:
python3 -m pip install --requirement tools/requirements.lock
python3 -B -m unittest tools.tests.test_consumer_inner_future_owner -v
timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=10s 2400s python3 -B tools/qualify_consumer_inner_future.py --source-commit "${{ github.sha }}" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/consumer-inner-future"

with.name: consumer-inner-future-${{ github.sha }}
with.path:
${{ runner.temp }}/consumer-inner-future/receipt.json
${{ runner.temp }}/consumer-inner-future/FAILED.json
${{ runner.temp }}/consumer-inner-future/source-inputs.json
${{ runner.temp }}/consumer-inner-future/commands.json
${{ runner.temp }}/consumer-inner-future/commands/logs/*.txt
${{ runner.temp }}/consumer-inner-future/fixtures/native-stream-outers.wasm
${{ runner.temp }}/consumer-inner-future/fixtures/native-stream-deferred.wasm

reviewReason: Retain bounded original-budget and private ownership controls at the exact source.
